senses.definition: A series of hits or blows directed at a person or object.
examples: The batter's hitting improved with practice.

quotes.text: The right hand of Curtis was open too much; but he nevertheless had the best of the hitting in this round, till Inglis bored him down, out of the ropes.
quotes.reference: 1824, Pierce Egan, Boxiana; Or, Sketches of Ancient and Modern Pugilism, page 600:

senses.definition: present participle and gerund of hit
